sources: https://www.blm.gov/visit/sweetwater-bridge-campground (read 2026-11-20): 'Sweetwater Bridge is one of seven recreation areas located on the Wind River Front. This campground includes eight sites, each with fire rings and picnic tables, two of which are pull-through sites. There is a vault toilet but no potable water available on site. This site is open year-round but access may be limited due to snowpack. This is a fee-free site; first come, first served.'; accessibility: 'The Sweetwater Bridge Campground has 6 drive-up or pull-through sites that are accessible and 2 walk-in campsites ... Cell phone service is unavailable.'; 'Campsite parking spurs are made of compacted road-base gravel ... There are no picnic shelters, but tree coverage provides some shade.'; managed by Rock Springs Field Office, 307-352-0256; coordinates 42.51925293, -109.0489047; directions 'From State Highway 28, turn north on to County Road 5-13/Continental Divide Road. Continue for 15 miles and turn east onto BLM Road 4105/Sweetwater Gap Ranch Road for 6 miles. Merge right to continue on BLM Road 4105 for 2 miles'; 'Fees No Fees'; 'Stay Limit 14 days'
recreation.gov search 'sweetwater bridge' (2026-11-20): campground 272294 'Sweetwater Bridge Campground', reservable false (information-only listing; no bookable facility)

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (800 m and 300 m frames at the BLM point): gravel loop and spurs on open sage east of the bridge plus a turnaround west of it; the Sweetwater River here is a ~10-15 m channel running through a willow band 20-40 m west/north of the nearest spurs; the BLM point (= stored pin) is in the willows just south of the loop road, within ~60 m of the spurs

note: BLM Rock Springs Field Office campground at the Sweetwater River bridge, one of seven recreation areas on the Wind River Front: from WY-28, 15 miles north on County Road 5-13 (Continental Divide Road), then 8 miles on BLM Road 4105. Some shade from trees; no cell service. --Claude
summary: BLM page read: 8 sites (6 drive-up/pull-through, 2 walk-in; 2 pull-through), vault toilet, no water, free, FCFS, year-round with snow caveat, 14-day limit - all confirmed (manual); rec.gov 272294 is info-only (reservable false) -> booking FCFS written. Not waterfront holds (river ~10-15 m wide behind willows). Pin = BLM point, fine. Phone/website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' holds. The Sweetwater River at the bridge is a ~10-15 m channel (creekside class by width) running through a willow band 20-40 m from the nearest spurs; no site has open ground to the water. Sites are unnumbered.
PIN: stored 42.51925293,-109.0489047 is the BLM point, in the willows just south of the loop road, within ~60 m of the spurs - fine.
PHONE/WEBSITE: 307-352-0256 (Rock Springs Field Office) confirmed on the BLM page; both website lines live (rec.gov 272294 is an information-only listing).
